passage.label: believe Allah Messenger Quran sent down Allah Acquainted what do; Day assemble Day Assembly Day Deprivation; whoever believes Allah does righteousness remove misdeeds admit gardens rivers flow abide forever great attainment; ones disbelieved denied verses companions Fire abiding eternally wretched destination; no disaster strikes except permission Allah whoever believes Allah guide heart Allah Knowing all things; obey Allah obey Messenger turn away upon Messenger only clear notification; Allah no deity except Him upon Allah let believers rely

arabicExcerpts.text: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلۡنَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحٗا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِ قَلۡبَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ

mainSubject.label: Belief in Allah, His Messenger and the sent-down Quran commanded under His acquaintance with deeds; the Day of Assembly named the Day of Deprivation where believers doing righteousness have misdeeds removed and are admitted to eternal rivered gardens as the great attainment while deniers become eternal Fire-companions in a wretched destination; no disaster striking except by Allah's permission with heart-guidance granted to whoever believes under His universal knowledge; obedience to Allah and the Messenger enjoined with the Messenger's duty limited to clear notification for whoever turns away; tawheed declared with reliance upon Allah alone commanded for believers

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلۡنَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Quran which We have sent down.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: And upon Allah let the believers rely.

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the resurrection oath and its ease (7) before the belief-Quran-Day of Assembly block opens (8); P2 ends with tawheed and reliance (13) before the domestic-enemy warning begins (14); P3 covers wives-children enmity, wealth-children trial, capacity-taqwa, the goodly loan and the closing name-pair (14-18).
